name: GhostToast
description: Themed toast stack: a themed GhostToastViewport that positions the portaled region as a fixed bottom-end stack and renders each record as a themed GhostToast, plus the themed GhostToast root with variant and tone hooks and enter-only motion. Provider, title, description, action, close, and useGhostToast are re-exported from @ghostvue/vue; all timers, queueing, announcements, and focus behavior stay on the headless parts.

props.name: toast
props.description: Record to render, usually one item of the viewport's toasts.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment. The default omits data-variant.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color intent. When unset, type 'error' maps to danger and other records to neutral. Neutral omits data-tone.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Toast content: title, description, action, and close parts.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Delegates to the unstyled GhostToast root.

parts.name: viewport
parts.description: Fixed bottom-end stack with .ghost-toast-viewport; data-inline (portal false) keeps it in normal flow.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Elevation-3 toast surface with .ghost-toast; plays the enter animation once on insert.

parts.name: action
parts.description: Compact outlined action button with a focus ring.

parts.name: close
parts.description: Compact icon-only dismiss button with a focus ring.

states.name: tone
states.description: data-tone='accent' | 'danger' tints the surface; solid fills it.

states.name: variant
states.description: data-variant='solid' fills the toast with the tone color.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-enter-duration
cssProperties.description: Enter animation duration. No animation under prefers-reduced-motion.
